Strings.port_forwarding.title: Port Forwarding
Strings.port_forwarding.description: Create loopback-only SSH tunnels from this device to localhost services on the RelaxKonOS server. Active tunnels and SSH settings are never synchronized.
Strings.port_forwarding.ssh_note: Leave host empty to use the host in the current RelaxKonOS connection; leave user empty to use the signed-in RelaxKonOS user. You can use a key agent/configuration or enter a password for the next SSH launch.
Strings.port_forwarding.fallback_note: If the requested local port is occupied, the next available loopback port is selected and returned below.
Strings.port_forwarding.editor_note: The target must be a loopback service on the RelaxKonOS server.
Strings.port_forwarding.forwards_hint: Each forward is bound only to localhost on this device and reaches a loopback service on the server.
Strings.port_forwarding.password_note: Optional. Used only for the next start or update, then cleared. It is never saved in the device settings file.
Strings.port_forwarding.status.settings_saved: Saved on this device only. The SSH password is not saved.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.ssh_port_invalid: SSH port must be between 1 and 65535.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.target_invalid: Enter a loopback target such as http://localhost:7000.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.local_port_invalid: The preferred local port must be between 1 and 65535.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.ssh_start_failed: Unable to start the local SSH client.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.forward_register_f: Could not register the started port forward.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.ssh_host_required: Connect to RelaxKonOS first, or set an SSH host in Port Forwarding settings.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.ssh_host_user_inva: SSH host and user cannot contain whitespace or start with '-'.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.no_local_port: No loopback TCP port is available on this device.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.remote_loopback_on: Only localhost and 127.0.0.1 services on the RelaxKonOS server can be forwarded.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.remote_port_invali: The remote port must be between 1 and 65535.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.web_scheme_only: Only HTTP and HTTPS links can be returned by this application.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.path_invalid: The forwarded link path must start with '/'.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.ssh_host_key: SSH host key verification failed. Connect once with your system SSH client and verify the server fingerprint.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.ssh_authentication: SSH authentication failed. Check the user, password, or key agent configuration.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.ssh_connection_ref: The SSH server refused the connection. Check the SSH host and port, and confirm that SSH is running on the server.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.ssh_host_unresolve: The SSH host name could not be resolved. Check the SSH host setting.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.ssh_unreachable: The SSH server cannot be reached. Check the network, host, port, and firewall.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.ssh_password_helpe: The local SSH password helper could not run. Use a key agent or check the local OpenSSH installation.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.ssh_startup_failed: SSH exited before the port forward became available. Check the SSH connection settings.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.target_timeout: The forwarded service did not respond within 5 seconds.
Strings.port_forwarding.error.target_unreachable: The local tunnel is running, but the service on the server loopback address could not be reached. Check that the target service is listening on the configured port.
